description: Battery-first phone/Windows companion for clipboard, screenshots, notifications, and file handoff.
notes: Conduit.exe is the user-facing control surface; conduit-daemon.exe runs silently in the background.
Pairing identity, history, Relay preferences, and tray preference live under %LOCALAPPDATA%\Conduit and survive Scoop updates/uninstall.
The installer preserves existing Start-at-sign-in and Explorer Send with Conduit choices when migrating or updating.
